# Agent Prompt - Sitio Tio Resort Frontend

## Objective
Build a complete frontend for **Sitio Tio Resort Hotel Booking** using **Tailwind CSS**.

## Requirements
- Tailwind CSS only
- Responsive, mobile-first
- scale sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl
- Clean UI
- Modern luxury resort style
- Batak Samosir inspired (red + gold accents)
- Reusable components

## Pages
1. Landing Page
2. Room Listing
3. Room Detail
4. Booking
5. Payment
6. Booking Success
7. User Dashboard
8. Admin Dashboard (UI)

## Components
- Navbar
- Hero
- Booking Search Form
- Room Card
- Facility Card
- Gallery
- Testimonial
- Footer
- Booking Stepper
- Payment Card
- Dashboard Cards

## Color Palette
Primary: #A61B1B
Secondary: #7F1416
Accent: #D4AF37
Background: #FAFAF9
Text: #111827

## Animations
- Fade
- Scale
- Hover
- Smooth scroll

## Folder Structure
```
resources/
 ├── js/
 ├── pages/
 ├── components/
 ├── layouts/
 └── assets/
```

## Rules
- Semantic HTML
- Accessibility
- Heroicons
- Poppins + Inter
- Rounded 2xl/3xl
- Soft shadows
- No Bootstrap
- Clean reusable code
